mission: Implement all findings from docs/assessments/rust-tui-ux-audit.md on the Rust Ratatui shell path.
nonGoals: No TypeScript/Ink UI resurrection or parity work outside the Rust CLI/TUI path.
No broad visual redesign beyond fixing the audited operator UX defects.
No new network calls or live target behavior.
globalInvariants: The Rust Ratatui shell remains the product TUI surface.
Strict plain/screen-reader output must remain line-oriented, no ANSI escapes, no box drawing, and width-safe.
Help, parser, keybind footer, and key handlers must not drift.
Long-view fixes must preserve deterministic rendering tests.
Existing operator safety language around aborts and model selection must remain truthful.

stories.title: Repair Plain Mode Command Feedback
stories.why: Plain/scripted mode currently hides logged errors, command echo, and exit acknowledgements, which breaks the accessibility and low-bandwidth surface.
acceptance: Scripted plain mode prints the submitted command or otherwise clearly identifies the command result block.
Plain mode prints new log entries produced by each command, including unknown-command errors and exit acknowledgements.
Plain mode keeps no ANSI escapes, no box drawing, and width-safe lines.
Regression tests cover /nope, /quit, /help followed by /quit, and a command that does not change ShellView.
stories.storyGate: cargo test -p kuzushi-tui plain && cargo test -p kuzushi-cli --test cutover_cli plain

stories.title: Add Viewport State For Long Views
stories.why: Long help/tools/modules/findings views are clipped with no viewport, and the findings cursor can move off-screen.
acceptance: Help, Tools, expanded Modules, Findings, History, and KB have a deterministic visible slice when content exceeds terminal height.
Findings rendering keeps the selected/cursor row visible after j/k/g/G/PageUp/PageDown.
Footer text tells operators when a view can scroll and which keys scroll it.
24-row TestBackend cases prove overflowing Help, Tools, Modules, and Findings remain navigable.
forbidden: unbounded line render in long views

stories.title: Unify Keybind Footer With Actual Hotkeys
stories.why: The footer omits useful hotkeys and advertises some actions as commands when the implementation handles bare keys.
acceptance: Findings footer advertises j/k, PgUp/PgDn, and Enter when those keys work.
ModuleRun/running footer advertises 1..4 actor drill-in and p/r pause/resume when available.
A single keybinding descriptor or equivalent shared mapping prevents handler/footer drift.
Tests prove advertised Findings and ModuleRun hotkeys map to real state transitions.
forbidden: footer command text for bare-key actions

stories.title: Expose Aliases And Examples In Help
stories.why: The parser accepts useful aliases and short forms, but /help only renders primary commands.
acceptance: /help displays high-value aliases/examples from ShellCommandSpec.aliases.
Help remains width-safe in TUI and strict plain mode.
Help includes examples for scan, use semgrep, run ., findings, open F-0001, and model.
Tests sample aliases from every command category and assert they are visible.
stories.storyGate: cargo test -p kuzushi-tui help && cargo test -p kuzushi-tui commands::tests

stories.title: Stabilize Async Agent Tests
stories.why: The full app test suite exposed a timing-sensitive fake-ask worker assertion.
acceptance: The fake ask test is deterministic under the full app::tests suite.
The test still separately proves immediate AgentChat running state and final answered state.
Failure diagnostics distinguish slow worker completion from wrong UI state.
Full app::tests passes repeatedly.

stories.title: Wrap Important Plain Output Instead Of Truncating
stories.why: Strict plain mode keeps lines safe but truncates important command shapes and next-step guidance.
acceptance: Plain-mode guidance/help lines wrap to width instead of losing command tails.
Table cells may still truncate when a nearby detail or command gives the full value.
Strict plain output remains no ANSI, no box drawing, and <=80 columns in tests.
Tests cover wrapped context/workspace/help guidance.
forbidden: ANSI or box drawing in plain output
